bind the community together: The yearly temple festival helps bind the community together as neighbors cook and celebrate side by side.
每年的廟會幫助凝聚社區，鄰居們一起做菜、一起慶祝。
bind a book: In the art class, we learned how to bind a book by hand with a needle and thread.
在美術課上，我們學會了如何用針線手工裝訂書。
blast the government: Angry farmers went on TV to blast the government for doing nothing about the low rice prices.
憤怒的農民上電視猛烈抨擊政府對低米價毫無作為。
blast music: My neighbor likes to blast music late at night, so I can hardly fall asleep.
我的鄰居喜歡在深夜大聲放音樂，害我幾乎睡不著。
blast off: Thousands of people watched the rocket blast off into the clear morning sky.
數千人看著火箭升空，飛向晴朗的早晨天空。
blast through the rock: Workers used dynamite to blast through the rock so the new tunnel could be finished on time.
工人用炸藥炸開岩石，好讓新隧道能如期完工。
blend in with the crowd: The famous singer wore a cap and sunglasses to blend in with the crowd at the train station.
那位知名歌手戴著帽子和太陽眼鏡，在火車站融入人群。
blend tradition with innovation: The new restaurant blends tradition with innovation by serving old family recipes in modern ways.
這家新餐廳融合傳統與創新，用現代方式呈現古早家傳料理。
blend colors: The art teacher showed us how to blend colors on the paper to paint a soft sunset sky.
美術老師示範如何在紙上調色，畫出柔和的夕陽天空。
be blessed with talent: Lily was blessed with talent for music and could play the piano beautifully at age five.
莉莉天生有音樂才華，五歲就能把鋼琴彈得很美。
bless the marriage: At the wedding, the priest asked God to bless the marriage of the young couple.
在婚禮上，牧師祈求上帝祝福這對年輕夫妻的婚姻。
a blessing in disguise: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise, because it pushed me to start my own business.
失去那份工作是因禍得福，因為它促使我自己創業。
block the road: A big tree fell during the typhoon and blocked the road to the village for two days.
颱風期間一棵大樹倒下，封住通往村莊的路兩天。
block a proposal: Several members voted against the plan to block a proposal that would raise school fees.
幾位委員投下反對票，阻擋一項會調漲學費的提案。
block someone on social media: After he kept sending her rude messages, she decided to block him on social media.
在他不斷傳送無禮訊息後，她決定在社群媒體上封鎖他。
block out the noise: Thick curtains and double windows help block out the noise from the busy street below.
厚窗簾和雙層窗有助於隔絕樓下繁忙街道的噪音。
the economy bloomed: After the new airport opened, the economy bloomed and many new hotels appeared in the area.
新機場啟用後，經濟蓬勃發展，該地區出現許多新飯店。
bloom into a star: The shy girl from a small village bloomed into a star after winning the singing contest.
那位來自小村莊的害羞女孩贏得歌唱比賽後，成長為明星。
in full bloom: In spring, the cherry trees in the park are in full bloom, and crowds come to take photos.
春天時，公園裡的櫻花樹盛開，人們成群來拍照。
blur the line between: Online games sometimes blur the line between the real world and the virtual one for young players.
線上遊戲有時會模糊年輕玩家真實世界與虛擬世界之間的界線。
blur the distinction: Fake news that looks like real reports can blur the distinction between facts and opinions.
看似真實報導的假新聞會模糊事實與意見之間的區別。
memories blur: As the years pass, memories blur, and I can no longer remember my first teacher's face.
隨著歲月流逝，記憶模糊了，我已記不得第一位老師的臉。
boast of one's success: He likes to boast of his success in business, telling everyone how much money he has made.
他喜歡吹噓自己在事業上的成功，告訴大家他賺了多少錢。
the city boasts a museum: The city boasts a museum of modern art that attracts thousands of visitors every weekend.
這座城市擁有一座現代美術館，每個週末吸引數千名遊客。
boast a long history: Many temples in Tainan boast a long history of more than three hundred years.
台南的許多廟宇擁有超過三百年的悠久歷史。
bolt the door: Before going to bed, Grandpa always checks the windows and bolts the door twice.
睡覺前，爺爺總會檢查窗戶並把門閂上兩次。
bolt out of the room: As soon as the bell rang, the kids bolted out of the room like a group of frightened rabbits.
鐘聲一響，孩子們就像一群受驚的兔子般衝出房間。
bolt down food: Don't bolt down food so fast; chew slowly or you will get a stomachache.
別吃得那麼狼吞虎嚥；慢慢嚼，不然你會胃痛。
a bolt from the blue: The news that our school would close next year came as a bolt from the blue to everyone.
我們學校明年要關閉的消息對大家來說如晴天霹靂。
